evidence: Full fifteen-stage isolated verifier on the current integrated candidate (input 7f3ff4fa33b2...): 522 tests, 4 opt-in skips, 0 failures, packaged unsigned app smoke and helper protocol check included.

Independent isolated rerun by the auditor: EndpointDeliveryRegressionTests 13, DiskStewardEndpointTests 4 (input c2e4ad38, 180 tests, 0 failures): deterministic fixture-only callback ordering with excluded intermediates, held delivery, bounded queue/worker overflow, genuine-gap preservation, authentication and late callbacks across stop/crash/restart. Acceptance: Sequential endpoint notifications, including excluded events between included events, retain order without false sequence gaps under deliberately delayed delivery. The callback-to-bridge queue and worker count are bounded before task creation; overflow exposes a truthful gap/fallback. Stop/crash/restart fence late callbacks and in-flight delivery from prior epochs. Deterministic tests use barriers/drain acknowledgments rather than fixed sleeps and preserve authentication and genuine-gap behavior.
Task evidence re-read against the current source; candidate hashes, red-before-green history and helper reconciliations are archived, not self-reported.

limitations: Fixture adapter contract only; no native EndpointSecurity activation, entitlement or native callback-concurrency proof.
